name: NMIMS NPAT
conducted_by: SVKM's NMIMS (Deemed-to-be University); test delivered by Pearson VUE

cycle_2026.application_window: Phase 1: 28 Jan – 22 Mar 2026; Phase 2: 23 Mar – 26 May 2026

selection_process: Merit list on NPAT score only (no interview/WAT). Common registration with campus preferences; Phase 1 admits can upgrade campus in Phase 2 by merit number and seat availability.

verbal_weight: 16 of 60 questions are General English (plus a WAT at some institutes)

name: Christ University Entrance Test
full_name: CHRIST (Deemed to be University) Entrance Test (often called CHRIST-CUET / ET-CU; not the NTA CUET)
mode: Online, remote-proctored test; SA/MP/PI in person at campus

cycle_2026.application_window: Multiple sessions: Session 1 closed 1 Dec 2025; Session 2 30 Mar 2026; Session 3 3 May 2026; Session 4 24 May 2026; Session 5 26 May – 7 Jun 2026
cycle_2026.fee: Reported differently: Careers360 says ₹8,000 (2026); reports for the 2027 cycle say ₹1,800 per programme. Confirm on the portal.

cycle_2027: Announced: applications opened 15 Oct 2026 (official NRI notice; news reports for UG). Session 1 test ~5 Dec 2026, SA/MP/PI 11–13 Dec 2026, final list 21 Dec 2026 (news reports; dates are on admit cards).
eligibility: Class XII (any stream) passed/appearing from a recognised board; no upper age limit. Some programmes add subject rules.

pattern.notes: Paper differs by programme group. BCom group: Fundamental Accounting, Maths, DI, Reasoning, GK, English — 20 each. Economics group: English 20, GK 15, Current Affairs 10, Reasoning 20, Maths 15, DI 15, Economics 25. Section split is from the university's older official test-details page; recheck the 2027 'CHRIST-CUET Guidelines & Test Pattern' PDF.

selection_process: Entrance Test (shortlist) → Skill Assessment (10-min written piece on one A4 sheet) → Micro Presentation (90 seconds on a topic) → Personal Interview (10 min). Class X/XI/XII marks are checked. Weightages are not published.
verbal_weight: BBA paper: 25 of 120 questions English; BCom paper: 20 of 120; plus a written Skill Assessment and spoken Micro Presentation

colleges.name: CHRIST Bangalore Central Campus
programmes: BCom (General, Accountancy & Taxation, Applied Finance & Analytics, Finance & Investment, International Finance, Strategic Finance, etc.)
colleges.fees: BBA (Hons) ~₹2.75 L/yr other states (₹2.55 L Karnataka); BCom (IAF) ~₹3.43 L/yr other states (Careers360, year unclear); BCom General ~₹90,000/yr other states (Collegedunia, older)

colleges.fees: ~₹2.49–2.66 L/yr for years 1–3, other states (Careers360, year unclear)

colleges.name: CHRIST Kengeri Campus
colleges.fees: ~₹2.6 L/yr years 1–3, ₹3.3 L year 4, other states (Careers360, year unclear)

colleges.name: CHRIST Yeshwanthpur Campus
colleges.fees: BBA ~₹2.75–2.87 L/yr; BCom (IAF) ~₹3.43 L/yr, other states (Careers360, year unclear)

notes: Several sessions each year; apply early because seats fill from Session 1. Test dates are system-assigned and cannot be changed. No cutoffs or seat counts are published. 'CUET' here means Christ's own test, not NTA CUET-UG.

name: Nirma University UG (IPMAT / Class XII route)
full_name: Nirma University UG management & commerce admissions (no own test)
mode: Uses IPMAT Indore score + PI (All India); Class XII merit (Gujarat / BCom)

cycle_2026.application_window: Integrated BBA-MBA: 4 Feb – 31 May 2026 (All India, extended); Gujarat seats till 25 May 2026. BCom (Hons): opened 16 Jan 2026, closed by May 2026
cycle_2026.result: Interviews from June 2026; merit lists on the admissions portal

eligibility: Integrated BBA-MBA (All India): 60% in XII + IPMAT score of that year. Gujarat seats: 90% in XII from a Gujarat school. BCom (Hons): 60% in XII with English + one of Accountancy/Business/Economics/Stats/Maths.

pattern.notes: No Nirma test. See the IPMAT Indore entry for the test pattern.

selection_process: Integrated BBA-MBA (All India & NRI-sponsored): IPMAT 50% + PI 30% + Class XII 20%. Gujarat seats: XII marks 70% + PI 30%. BCom (Hons): XII total marks only (tie-break on English).
verbal_weight: Via IPMAT (Verbal section); no Nirma-specific test

colleges.name: Institute of Commerce, Nirma University
colleges.selection: Class XII merit only; no entrance test

notes: Nirma also lists a BBA (Hons) with a 10 May 2026 deadline (Collegedunia), but its selection rules could not be confirmed from an official page.
